title: update footer to show sync status like dropbox
add SwiftGit2 dependency to macOS app and sync daemon
description: Add SwiftGit2 via Swift Package Manager to both macOS app and sync daemon. This gives us access to libgit2 for reading git info without git CLI.

title: create GitInfoReader helper using SwiftGit2
description: Implement GitInfoReader class that uses SwiftGit2 to read: remote URL, current branch, commit SHA, repo name. Replace manual .git/config parsing.

title: add git tracking fields to database schema
description: Migration: ALTER TABLE sources ADD git_repo_url, git_repo_name, git_default_branch. ALTER TABLE issues ADD git_branch, git_commit, git_pr_url, git_pr_number. Add indexes.

title: update Swift models to include git fields
description: Add git fields to Source and Issue structs in Models.swift (both Shared and sync). Update CodingKeys for snake_case API compatibility.

title: update sync daemon to capture git info automatically
description: When syncing issues, use GitInfoReader to detect git context (branch, commit SHA, repo URL). Send to cloud API. Update source registration to include git repo info.

title: add GET /api/repositories endpoint
description: New API endpoint to list all repositories with issue counts. Query: SELECT git_repo_url, COUNT(*) FROM sources JOIN issues GROUP BY git_repo_url. Return repo list with open/closed counts.

title: add repository filter to issues API endpoint
description: Update GET /api/issues to support ?git_repo_url filter. Join with sources table to filter issues by repository.

title: add repositories page to web app
description: Create /repositories page showing all repos with issue counts. Click repo to see filtered issues. Design: repo name, URL, total issues, open count.

title: add repository filter to web app issues page
description: Add repository dropdown filter on issues page. Fetch from GET /api/repositories. Filter issues by selected repo.

title: display git context on issue detail page
description: Show git info on issue detail: repo, branch, commit SHA with GitHub link. Format: https://github.com/user/repo/commit/abc123. Add icons/badges.
